title: Devin Booker Is Stanley's First NBA Partner
htmlContent:
Devin Bookerhas spent more than a decade proving he can score from anywhere on the floor. Now the Phoenix Suns star is making his mark somewhere new: the drinkware aisle. Stanley 1913, the brand behind some of the most recognizable tumblers in America, has named Booker its first-ever NBA player partner, and the two are debuting a capsule called "Hidden in Plain Sight."

The partnership is a first for both sides. Stanley has worked with athletes and personalities before, but never an active NBA player. For Booker, it is a chance to show fans a side of his life that rarely makes the highlight reels.

What's in the Collection

The "Hidden in Plain Sight" capsule is built for everyday use rather than display. The lineup includes 24-ounce and 64-ounce tumblers, an insulated pet bowl, a stainless steel lunchbox and a party set. Every piece comes in two colorways: a bold orange and a tiger camo pattern.

Pricing runs from $40 to $150, putting the collection in line with Stanley's premium positioning while keeping several items within reach for fans who simply want a piece of Booker's world on their desk, in their truck or at the trailhead.

The mix of products is telling. This is not a collection of jerseys and sneakers. It is a set of tools for long drives, outdoor afternoons and evenings spent with friends, which is exactly the point.

Built Around Booker's Life Off the Court

According to Yahoo Sports, the capsule draws its inspiration from how Booker spends his time away from basketball. That means offseason road trips, hikes with his dogs around Flagstaff and game nights with friends.

Flagstaff, roughly two hours north of Phoenix, offers a cooler, pine-covered escape from the desert heat, and it gives the collection a strong sense of place. The insulated pet bowl is a direct nod to Booker's dogs and his time on the trails with them. The 64-ounce tumbler and the lunchbox fit the road-trip theme, while the party set speaks to the game nights that keep him grounded during the grind of an NBA calendar.

The name "Hidden in Plain Sight" ties it all together. The tiger camo pattern blends into the outdoors, and the collection itself reflects a version of Booker that fans often overlook: the quieter, more personal life behind one of the league's most polished scorers.

Why the Partnership Makes Sense for Stanley

Stanley has been around for more than a century, but its recent run has turned the brand into a cultural phenomenon. Its tumblers became must-have items on social media, with limited drops selling out quickly and collectors chasing new colors.

Partnering with an NBA star opens a new lane. Basketball fans are among the most engaged consumers in sports, and they follow players' style choices closely, from tunnel fits to the gear they carry. Booker brings credibility with that audience, along with a laid-back, authentic image that matches Stanley's rugged roots.

Choosing Booker as the first NBA partner also signals that Stanley is interested in personality, not just star power. The collection is rooted in real habits and real places, which gives it more staying power than a simple logo swap.

Booker's Growing Brand

On the court, Booker has built a résumé that few players his age can match. The former Kentucky Wildcat was drafted 13th overall by Phoenix in 2015 and grew into the franchise's cornerstone. He has earned multiple All-Star selections, once poured in 70 points in a single game and helped Team USA win Olympic gold at the 2024 Paris Games.

Off the court, he has steadily expanded his footprint through business and lifestyle ventures. The Stanley deal fits that pattern. It connects his name to a product people use every day and positions him as a voice for the outdoors, travel and downtime, not just basketball.

The Bottom Line

The "Hidden in Plain Sight" collection is a smart, grounded first step for Stanley's entry into the NBA world. It reflects who Devin Booker is when the arena lights are off: a guy who likes the open road, the mountain air around Flagstaff and a good night in with friends.

For fans, it is a chance to bring a little of that life home, whether that means filling a tiger camo tumbler for a long drive or setting out an orange pet bowl after a hike. For Stanley, it is a sign that the brand's next chapter may run straight through the hardwood.
excerpt: Phoenix Suns star Devin Booker has been named Stanley 1913's first-ever NBA player partner, debuting a capsule collection called "Hidden in Plain Sight" featuring tumblers, an insulated pet bowl, a stainless steel lunchbox, and a party set inspired by Booker's life off the court.
